title: The tournament organizer needs your login
scenario: An esports organizer emails saying your team passed qualifiers but your game account must be linked for anti-cheat checks. The link asks for your game username, password and an MFA code.

answers.A: Ask your coach/team lead to confirm the organizer and anti-cheat requirements.
answers.B: Link the account because anti-cheat systems legitimately need deep access.
answers.C: Verify the tournament on the official organizer/game site and use only its documented account-linking process.

explanation: Real anti-cheat tools may need software or account permissions, but they should not ask you to hand over credentials through an email link.
proTip: Legitimate deep access still comes through legitimate installation paths.
